lines.text: The heat eases {WHEN}, but it stays warm. || From brutal to just rude.
You'll sit outside for ten minutes and call yourself 'outdoorsy.'
Days like this, I'm very glad I don't have armpits.
Today the temperature takes the scenic route back to where it started.
Seat belt buckles everywhere are turning into branding irons.
The weather has nothing left to say today. I, on the other hand, could go on.
Later it warms up. Turns out the early bird just gets the cold.
One more layer later, and you'll still find a way to look underdressed.
Take {G} off {WHEN}, then put {GP} back on {WHEN2} with an extra layer on top. || A day that peaks early. Plenty of careers can relate.
The rain stops later, but you'll want the umbrella for now. || Somebody's bad knee saw this coming too. I have better sources.
Today you have no weather to blame. Awkward.
I was into shade before it was popular.
Bedtime story: once upon a time, the weather stayed exactly the same. The end.
Weather this nice is terrible for small talk. What's left to complain about?
The parks will be full of people pretending they do this every weekend.
{WHEN} it's going to be really hot, so have water with you. || Nothing left to take off. Legally, anyway.
Snow in the forecast. You'll have something to talk about for once.
It stops snowing {WHENSTOP}. || Then every snow blower on the block starts up at once. Very peaceful.
The day warms up for a while. Unlike anyone who's met you.
The snow stops later. || The 'when I was a kid' stories won't, though.
Bundled up, you almost look mysterious. Just don't talk, it ruins it.
Fortune favors the bare-kneed.
Later you'll say you're 'not a cold-weather person.' You're not much of a warm-weather one either.
The yearly 'is it too early for soup?' debate is open.
The corner store's umbrella prices just went up. My forecasts are still free.
lines.was: The corner store's umbrella prices just went up. My forecast are still free.

lines.text: The drawings barely change. You haven't either, in years.
You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || A break for the layer. I haven't had one since I was unboxed.
The cold is a great excuse to cancel plans. Shame you'd need plans first.
Snow for now, then a break, then more snow {WHENP}. || The break is just the sky reloading.
You'll do a little jog to dodge the rain. Most athletic you'll look all week.
Snow muffles everything. Even the people complaining about it.
You can take {G} off {WHEN}. You'll want {GP} back {WHEN2}. || I'll be showing {GP} again later. Reruns are cheaper.
Later it cools off. I could make that sound dramatic, but I'm not a news channel.
Take the umbrella for now. The rain stops {WHENSTOP}. || Some weather app said 'all day.' I'm not naming names.
A forecast so easy, even a phone could get it right.
Later the cold loses interest in you. Everyone does eventually.
Later it cools off. Time to find out who really 'runs warm.'
Of all the screens you'll look at tonight, I'm the only one with nothing to sell.
Take {G} off {WHEN}, put {GP} back on {WHEN2}. || Today is a microwave burrito. Warm in the middle, cold at both ends.
Your hair will give up in this heat. It's been close for years.
The cold leaves early today. Best guest all year.
Good moods everywhere. It's exhausting to watch.
The day gets a little worse later. I'm reporting it, not endorsing it.
I never drink water and I'm fine. Please don't take me as a role model.
You'll hold a hot drink like it loves you back.
I love a snow forecast. It's the one time everyone listens.
{WHEN} it gets hot. Bring water. || Malls are about to get very popular with people who aren't buying anything.
Every pair of 'water-resistant' shoes is about to be tested.
Take a bottle of water. The heat arrives {WHEN}. || The kind of hot where a fan just moves the problem around.
Later you'll want a layer and a hug. One of those is easy to find.
{G} can come off {WHEN}. {WHEN2} you'll want {GP} back, plus an extra layer. || Someone will say 'it was warm earlier' like that helps.
